scope: Cazas Zahle, West Bekaa, Rachaya (Bekaa governorate); Baalbek, Hermel (Baalbek-Hermel governorate). Types: PHC centres, public hospitals, private hospitals.

sources.name: MoPH Health Facility Locator (facility_type=1 public hospitals, 8 private hospitals, 4 PHC centers), all pages, plus each facility detail page
sources.method: Browser on user device; in-page fetch() of every list page per type (public 2 pages, private 5, PHC 8), filtered client-side to the 5 cazas (caza spellings: Zahle/زحلة, West Bekaa/البقاع الغربي, Rachaya/راشيا, Baalbek/BAALBECK/Baalabak/بعلبك, Hermel/HERMEL/الهرمل); detail pages parsed for Address/Status/Ownership/beds. NB the site's own district filter misses rows with variant caza spellings (e.g. Baalbeck governmental hospital).
sources.fields: name_en, name_ar, caza, address, phone, registry status, beds

sources.name: MoPH 'مراكز شبكة الرعاية الصحية الاولية' PDF, header date 27/03/2025 (327 centres nationally; Bekaa 36, Baalbek-Hermel 26)
sources.method: Direct download blocked by egress proxy and the URL returned 404 from the browser on 2026-11-21; content obtained via two independent WebFetch text extractions which agreed on all names/addresses; transcribed to network_2025.py. Phone numbers in the PDF are written right-to-left (e.g. 508484-08) and were normalised to 08-508484. Matched to locator rows manually by village + name (32 matches).
sources.caveat: Text-extraction route; spot-check against the PDF before publication. MoPH 2025 Annual PHC Dashboard reports 37 Bekaa and 28 Baalbek-Hermel network centres, i.e. 3 more than this March-2025 list — those are missing here.

Bekaa Gharbi Hospital still listed with partial damage; ~41 PHCCs closed nationally (no names)
context only: 51 PHCCs closed, 8 operating for chronic/emergency only nationally; no facility names
Baalbek Governmental Hospital (MSF PICU set-up) and Libano-Francais Hospital Zahle ('existing operational hospital') functional

sources.method: Run from browser tab on nominatim origin, 1.2 s between requests, viewbox 35.55,33.30-36.75,34.75 bounded, countrycodes=lb. Facility queries: English (and Arabic for hospitals) names; accepted only amenity=hospital results whose OSM name matches the MoPH name. 21/29 hospitals matched; 0/68 PHC centres matched. Village centroid queries (Arabic village from MoPH address) stored separately in village_lat/village_lon — NOT facility locations.

coord_confidence.high: OSM hospital name matches MoPH name and OSM locality agrees with MoPH address
coord_confidence.medium: name partially matches or OSM locality differs from MoPH address (noted in coord_source)

not_found: No dispensaries: neither the MoPH locator nor the network PDF has a 'dispensary' category for these cazas; MoPH 'مستوصفات' are folded into PHC/locator lists or not published.

No facility-level 2026 closure list for Bekaa/Baalbek-Hermel: WHO/Health Sector sitreps give national closed-PHCC counts only (43 on 5 Mar 2026 rising to 59 on 10 Apr, 46 on 24 Apr, ~41 on 8 May); WHO sitrep 1 has a map of closed PHCCs (image only).
